impact.text: theft of up to 100% of tokens held by the pair

precondition_sources.text: There are some non-zero accrued launchpad fees on the GTELaunchPadV2Pair.
Reserves are calculated as current balances minus accrued fees within the _update function.
The attacker does not transfer any tokens into the contract prior to calling swap.

intent_sources.text: When inferring the amount(s) transferred in by the user, the accrued launchpad fees must be subtracted off so the amounts can be accurately measured.
